extDescription.message: Fills and saves your logins in Verrou, the password manager for Vaultwarden.

pairBusy.message: Linking is already in progress: try again in a moment.

pairNoAnswer.message: Verrou is not responding. Is it installed, with "$SETTING$" turned on in its settings? ($DETAIL$)

pillUnpairedTitle.message: The extension is not linked to Verrou

pillUnpairedHint.message: Link it from its icon in the toolbar

pillLinkHint.message: Link this site to a Verrou login

passkeyOfflineTitle.message: Verrou can't be reached: the passkey is left to the browser

passkeyOfflineHint.message: Open Verrou, and turn on "$SETTING$" in its settings.

passkeyUnpairedTitle.message: The extension is not linked to Verrou: the passkey is left to the browser

passkeyUnpairedHint.message: Link the extension from its icon in the toolbar.

passkeyOutdatedTitle.message: Verrou was just updated: the passkey is left to the browser

passkeyOutdatedHint.message: Reload the page to use Verrou's passkeys.

passkeyAlgorithmTitle.message: Verrou doesn't support this key type: the passkey is left to the browser

passkeyAlgorithmHint.message: The site doesn't accept ES256 keys, the only ones Verrou can create.

passkeyOtherTitle.message: Verrou couldn't take the request: the passkey is left to the browser

passkeySignInTitle.message: Sign in with a Verrou passkey?

passkeyExists.message: This passkey is already in Verrou

popupCheckCode.message: Check that Verrou shows the same code, then accept:

popupCodesDiffer.message: If the codes differ, refuse in Verrou.

popupPairIntro.message: Link the extension to the Verrou app on this Mac to fill your logins.

popupScanQr.message: Add the QR code on screen

popupEnterKeyLink.message: or enter the key by hand

popupTwoFactorIntro.message: The site shows a QR code for an authenticator app: Verrou can keep it and generate the codes.

popupAutoSubmitHint.message: Only for a sign-in, when nothing is left to type and no captcha is visible.

popupChooseLogin.message: Choose the login to use on $HOST$.

popupConfirmLink.message: Add $HOST$ to "$TITLE$"? Verrou will then suggest it on this site. Check the address carefully: a phishing site often imitates the one it targets.

popupQrUnsupported.message: this browser can't read QR codes: enter the key by hand

popupNoQr.message: No two-factor QR code visible: bring it up on screen, or enter the key.

popupSecretKey.message: The secret key shown by the site ("setup key"):

popupCodeAdded.message: Code added. Verrou now generates this site's codes: enter the current code to finish turning it on at the site.

popupVersionHowFirefox.message: In about:debugging › This Firefox, reload it, or load the manifest.json from the "extension-firefox" folder of Verrou.app (Verrou Settings › Browsers and Terminal › Firefox extension › Copy Path). Installed add-on (.xpi): install the one from the new version.

popupVersionHowBrave.message: In brave://extensions, load the "extension" folder of Verrou.app (Verrou Settings › Browsers and Terminal › Copy Path), or reload it.

popupVersionTitle.message: This extension is not the one Verrou ships

popupAccessGranted.message: Access granted: reload the pages already open.

popupAccessDenied.message: Access denied: Verrou won't be able to fill anything.

popupNoSiteAccess.message: Verrou has no access to sites

popupSiteAccessText.message: Firefox asks for your consent so the extension can fill your logins and offer your passkeys on pages.

popupOfflineText.message: Open the app and turn on "$SETTING$" in its settings. Until then, no filling and no passkeys: the browser takes over.

extSafariDescription.message: Signs you in once iOS AutoFill has filled a login from Verrou.
